chapters.title: The Beginning of Knowledge
chapters.synopsis: Solomon opens his collection of proverbs and declares that the fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge. He warns his son against joining sinners who lie in wait for blood, and wisdom herself cries aloud in the streets against those who refuse her counsel.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: The purpose of proverbs; wisdom cries in the streets

chapters.title: Searching for Wisdom as Treasure
chapters.synopsis: Solomon urges his son to seek wisdom as men search for silver and hidden treasures. Those who find it receive understanding from the Lord, and it preserves them from the ways of evil men and the flattering stranger.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Seek wisdom like hid treasure; it preserves the upright

chapters.title: Trust in the Lord Wholly
chapters.synopsis: Solomon counsels his son to trust in the Lord with all his heart and lean not on his own understanding. He teaches that the Lord chastens those he loves, and pronounces happy the man who finds wisdom, whose ways are ways of pleasantness and peace.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Trust the Lord; happy is the man that findeth wisdom

chapters.title: Get Wisdom, Get Understanding
chapters.synopsis: Solomon recalls the instruction his own father gave him and passes it to his children: wisdom is the principal thing, so get wisdom at any cost. The path of the just shines brighter unto the perfect day, and he charges his son to keep his heart with all diligence.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: A father's charge: wisdom is the principal thing

chapters.title: Rejoice with the Wife of Thy Youth
chapters.synopsis: Solomon warns his son against the strange woman whose end is bitter as wormwood. He counsels faithfulness instead, urging him to drink from his own cistern and rejoice with the wife of his youth, for the ways of man are before the eyes of the Lord.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Flee the strange woman; be faithful in marriage

chapters.title: Go to the Ant, Thou Sluggard
chapters.synopsis: Solomon warns against rash pledges of surety and sends the sluggard to learn diligence from the ant. He lists seven things the Lord hates, including a proud look and hands that shed innocent blood, and again warns that adultery destroys the soul.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: The ant's diligence; seven things the Lord hates

chapters.title: The Flattering Words of Folly
chapters.synopsis: Solomon tells of watching a young man void of understanding drawn away by the flattering words of a seductress. The youth follows her as an ox goes to the slaughter, and Solomon pleads with his sons not to stray into her paths, for her house is the way to death.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: A cautionary tale of the youth and the seductress

chapters.title: Wisdom Cries at the Gates
chapters.synopsis: Wisdom is personified as a woman crying at the gates of the city, offering counsel better than rubies. She declares that she was with the Lord before the creation of the earth, rejoicing always before him, and that all who find her find life.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Wisdom personified; she was with the Lord at creation

chapters.title: Wisdom Hath Builded Her House
chapters.synopsis: Wisdom builds her house on seven pillars and spreads a feast, inviting the simple to forsake foolishness and live. The foolish woman also calls from her doorway, but her guests do not know that the dead are there. The fear of the Lord remains the beginning of wisdom.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Two feasts: wisdom's invitation and folly's snare

chapters.title: A Wise Son Maketh Glad
chapters.synopsis: Solomon begins his great collection of two-line sayings, contrasting the righteous and the wicked. A wise son makes a glad father, the memory of the just is blessed, and hatred stirs strife while love covers all sins.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Couplets contrasting the righteous and the wicked

chapters.title: A Just Weight Is His Delight
chapters.synopsis: Solomon teaches that a false balance is abomination to the Lord but a just weight is his delight. Pride brings shame while with the lowly is wisdom, and the liberal soul that waters others shall itself be watered.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Honest dealing, humility, and the generous soul

chapters.title: Whoso Loveth Instruction
chapters.synopsis: Solomon contrasts those who love instruction with those who hate reproof. A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband, a righteous man regards the life of his beast, and lying lips are abomination to the Lord.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Instruction, truthful lips, and diligent labor

chapters.title: The Light of the Righteous
chapters.synopsis: Solomon teaches that a wise son hears his father's instruction and that hope deferred makes the heart sick. The light of the righteous rejoices, wealth gotten by vanity diminishes, and he that spares the rod fails to love his son.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Hope, honest wealth, and a father's correction

chapters.title: Every Wise Woman Buildeth Her House
chapters.synopsis: Solomon observes that every wise woman builds her house while the foolish plucks it down with her hands. There is a way that seems right to a man whose end is death, righteousness exalts a nation, and the fear of the Lord is a fountain of life.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Building the house; righteousness exalteth a nation

chapters.title: A Soft Answer Turneth Away Wrath
chapters.synopsis: Solomon teaches that a soft answer turns away wrath but grievous words stir up anger. The eyes of the Lord are in every place, a merry heart makes a cheerful countenance, and better is a dinner of herbs where love is than a stalled ox with hatred.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Gentle speech, a merry heart, and love at table

chapters.title: Pride Goeth Before Destruction
chapters.synopsis: Solomon counsels committing one's works to the Lord, who weighs the spirits and directs a man's steps. Pride goes before destruction and a haughty spirit before a fall, and he that rules his spirit is better than he that takes a city.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: The Lord directs our steps; pride precedes a fall

chapters.title: A Friend Loveth at All Times
chapters.synopsis: Solomon prizes a dry morsel with quietness above a house full of strife. A friend loves at all times and a brother is born for adversity, children's children are the crown of old men, and a merry heart does good like a medicine.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Friendship, family peace, and a cheerful heart

chapters.title: A Strong Tower and a Brother
chapters.synopsis: Solomon declares that the name of the Lord is a strong tower into which the righteous run and are safe. He warns against answering a matter before hearing it, notes that death and life are in the power of the tongue, and praises the friend that sticks closer than a brother.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: The Lord a strong tower; the tongue's power

chapters.title: Better the Poor in Integrity
chapters.synopsis: Solomon teaches that a poor man walking in integrity is better than a fool with perverse lips. He that has pity on the poor lends to the Lord, and parents are urged to chasten their sons while there is hope.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Integrity above riches; mercy to the poor

chapters.title: Wine Is a Mocker
chapters.synopsis: Solomon warns that wine is a mocker and strong drink is raging, and that whoever is deceived thereby is not wise. He commends the just man whose children are blessed after him and condemns divers weights and false balances as abomination to the Lord.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Sobriety, honest measures, and the just man's walk

chapters.title: The King's Heart in His Hand
chapters.synopsis: Solomon teaches that the king's heart is in the hand of the Lord, who turns it as the rivers of water. To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice, and there is no wisdom nor counsel against the Lord.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: The Lord weighs hearts; justice above sacrifice

chapters.title: A Good Name Above Riches
chapters.synopsis: Solomon declares that a good name is rather to be chosen than great riches. He counsels parents to train up a child in the way he should go, warns against oppressing the poor, and begins a section of the words of the wise.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: A good name; train up a child

chapters.title: Apply Thine Heart to Instruction
chapters.synopsis: Solomon warns against laboring to be rich, for wealth makes itself wings and flies away. He urges his son to buy the truth and sell it not, to hearken to the father that begat him, and paints a vivid picture of the woes that follow wine.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Buy the truth; honor thy parents; shun wine

chapters.title: Through Wisdom Is a House Builded
chapters.synopsis: Solomon teaches that through wisdom a house is built and by understanding it is established. He counsels against envying evil men, observes that a just man falls seven times and rises again, and describes the field of the slothful overgrown with thorns.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Wisdom builds; the just rise after falling

chapters.title: Proverbs Copied for Hezekiah
chapters.synopsis: These proverbs of Solomon were copied out by the men of King Hezekiah. It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, a word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver, and feeding a hungry enemy heaps coals of fire upon his head.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Words fitly spoken; kindness to an enemy

chapters.title: Answering a Fool's Folly
chapters.synopsis: Solomon describes the fool, the sluggard who turns on his bed as a door on its hinges, and the talebearer whose words are as wounds. Where no wood is, the fire goes out, and he that digs a pit shall fall therein.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Portraits of the fool, sluggard, and talebearer

chapters.title: Boast Not of Tomorrow
chapters.synopsis: Solomon warns against boasting of tomorrow, for no one knows what a day may bring forth. Faithful are the wounds of a friend, iron sharpens iron as a man sharpens the countenance of his friend, and he counsels diligent care of one's flocks.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Humility about tomorrow; iron sharpeneth iron

chapters.title: The Righteous Bold as a Lion
chapters.synopsis: Solomon observes that the wicked flee when no man pursues, but the righteous are bold as a lion. He that covers his sins shall not prosper, but whoever confesses and forsakes them shall have mercy, and a faithful man shall abound with blessings.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Boldness of the righteous; confessing brings mercy

chapters.title: Where There Is No Vision
chapters.synopsis: Solomon teaches that where there is no vision the people perish, but he that keeps the law is happy. The rod and reproof give wisdom while a child left to himself brings his mother to shame, and the fear of man brings a snare.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Vision, correction of children, and trust in the Lord

chapters.title: Two Things Have I Required
chapters.synopsis: The collection preserves the sayings of Agur, who confesses himself more brutish than any man and asks for neither poverty nor riches. Every word of God is pure, and the sayings marvel at things too wonderful to know, numbering wonders by threes and fours.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Agur's humble sayings; neither poverty nor riches

chapters.title: The Virtuous Woman
chapters.synopsis: The chapter records the words King Lemuel learned from his mother, warning kings against wine and urging them to plead the cause of the poor. It closes with the portrait of the virtuous woman whose price is far above rubies, whose children arise and call her blessed.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Lemuel's lesson; the virtuous woman praised
